description: End-to-end checkout workflow for purchasing connectivity services via a telecom-as-a-service (TaaS) cloud exchange, including quote building, availability checks, order placement, provisioning, modifications, and rollback.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer account in the cloud exchange.

cart_id.description: Identifier for a temporary cart holding requested connectivity items prior to order placement.

quote_id.description: Identifier for a generated price quote based on a cart or specific configuration.

order_id.description: Identifier of a submitted order in the cloud exchange.

connection_id.description: Identifier of a provisioned connectivity instance (e.g., a virtual circuit or interconnect).

availability_request_id.description: Identifier for an asynchronous capacity/availability request.

payment_profile_id.description: Identifier for a saved payment profile or billing arrangement.

functions.name: search_connectivity_offers
functions.description: Search and filter available connectivity offers on the cloud exchange marketplace.

customer_id.description: Customer requesting offers; used for eligibility and pricing rules.

filters.description: Filter criteria applied when searching for offers.

provider_ids.description: Limit results to specific connectivity providers.

regions.description: Regions in which connectivity must be available.

cloud_providers.description: Cloud providers that the connectivity must support.

tags.description: Arbitrary market tags to filter offers by capabilities.

functions.returns: A paginated list of matching connectivity offers with summarized pricing and capabilities.

functions.name: create_or_update_cart
functions.description: Create a new cart or update an existing cart with selected connectivity items and configurations.

cart_id.description: Existing cart to be updated; if omitted, a new cart is created.

customer_id.description: Owner of the cart and eventual order.

items.description: Connectivity items to add or update in the cart.

action.description: Action to perform on this item.

cart_item_id.description: Existing cart item ID when updating or removing.

offer_id.description: Identifier of the selected connectivity offer.

colo_id.description: Colocation facility ID (if type is colo).

address.description: Street address or free-form location description.

vlan.description: VLAN ID to use at this endpoint.

bandwidth_mbps.description: Requested bandwidth for this endpoint in Mbps.

separate_failure_domains.description: If true, paths must traverse distinct failure domains.

bgp.description: BGP-specific configuration when routing_type is bgp.

commit_bandwidth_mbps.description: Committed bandwidth in Mbps if billing_model is committed.

metadata.description: Free-form key-value tags applied to this cart item.

cart_level_discounts.description: Optional discount codes or promotions applied at cart level.

functions.returns: The updated cart with calculated subtotals, applied discounts, and a cart_id.

functions.name: check_connectivity_availability
functions.description: Check capacity and feasibility for the connectivity items in a cart or for a standalone configuration.

availability_request_id.description: Existing availability request to re-check or poll; if omitted, a new request is created.

cart_id.description: Cart to validate. If provided, items in the cart are used.

inline_config.description: Optional standalone configuration when not using a cart.

offers.description: List of offers and desired quantities to validate.

location_id.description: Location identifier such as colo ID or cloud region.

async_mode.description: If true, returns an availability_request_id and performs checks asynchronously.

functions.returns: Immediate availability result or an availability_request_id for asynchronous polling, including per-item feasibility and capacity details.

functions.name: get_availability_status
functions.description: Retrieve the status and results of a previously initiated connectivity availability request.

availability_request_id.description: Identifier of the availability request to query.

include_details.description: If true, returns detailed per-path and per-endpoint capacity insights.

functions.returns: Status of the availability request (pending, completed, failed) and detailed availability results if completed.

functions.name: generate_connectivity_quote
functions.description: Generate a detailed commercial quote for the items in a cart, including taxes, fees, and terms.

cart_id.description: Cart for which to generate a quote.

customer_id.description: Customer requesting the quote; used for tax calculation and eligibility.

pricing_overrides.description: Optional manual pricing inputs for privileged users.

allowed.description: If true, indicates that overrides are permitted (e.g., by a sales engineer).

unit_price_override.description: Overridden unit price (monthly) for this item.

currency.description: Currency code for the override, e.g., USD.

reason.description: Reason or reference ID for the override.

discount_percent.description: Global discount percentage applied at cart level.

auto_expire.description: If true, quote automatically becomes invalid after valid_until.

functions.returns: A quote_id and a detailed pricing breakdown including recurring charges, one-time fees, taxes, and total amounts.

functions.name: review_quote_and_prepare_checkout
functions.description: Retrieve a quote and prepare all information needed for checkout, including payment options and compliance checks.

quote_id.description: Quote to be reviewed prior to order submission.

include_payment_profiles.description: If true, include a list of available payment profiles and terms.

include_compliance_flags.description: If true, run compliance checks and return any required approvals.

functions.returns: Quote details, summary of cart items, available payment profiles, compliance flags, and any checkout prerequisites.

functions.name: submit_connectivity_order
functions.description: Submit an order based on an approved quote and checkout data, including payment and contract terms.

quote_id.description: Quote being converted to an order.

payment.description: Payment method and billing details for the order.

payment_profile_id.description: Existing saved payment profile to use.

method.description: Payment method type when not using a profile.

one_time_token.description: Optional token for ephemeral payment authorization.

contract.description: Contractual and legal information for the order.

master_agreement_id.description: Reference to an existing master service agreement.

accept_terms.description: Indicates that customer has accepted terms and conditions.

activation_preferences.description: Activation and scheduling preferences for provisioning.

requested_start.description: Requested activation time if activation_mode is scheduled.

time_zone.description: Time zone for requested_start, e.g., UTC or America/New_York.

metadata.description: Free-form order metadata such as internal reference numbers.

functions.returns: An order_id, initial order status, and summary of provisioning steps to be executed.

functions.name: get_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve the status and detailed timeline of a connectivity order, including provisioning tasks.

include.description: Additional information sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Current order status, per-item states, provisioning task states, and optionally billing summary and audit log.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_order_provisioning
functions.description: Handle provisioning failures by retrying failed steps or rolling back partially provisioned connectivity.

order_id.description: Order for which provisioning errored or needs recovery.

target_items.description: Specific order item IDs affected by the recovery action, when applicable.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for the recovery action.

options.description: Extra parameters depending on the strategy.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed steps.

skip_validation.description: If true, bypass some pre-checks when retrying or rolling back.

notify_customer.description: If true, send customer notifications about the recovery action.

functions.returns: Recovery job status, including which items or steps were scheduled for retry or rollback.

functions.name: list_connections
functions.description: List and filter provisioned connectivity instances (connections) for a customer.

customer_id.description: Customer whose connections will be listed.

filters.description: Filter options to narrow down connections.

functions.returns: A paginated list of connections with high-level attributes, statuses, and identifiers.

functions.name: modify_connection
functions.description: Modify an existing connectivity instance, such as bandwidth change, endpoint updates, or billing plan change.

bandwidth_change.description: Modify the committed or maximum bandwidth.

new_config.description: Updated endpoint config for add/update actions.

routing_changes.description: Modify routing settings, including BGP parameters.

change_control.description: Change control and maintenance window settings.

functions.returns: A modification request identifier, its initial status, and expected impact/activation timings.

functions.name: cancel_or_suspend_connection
functions.description: Cancel a pending connection or suspend/terminate an active connectivity instance.

connection_id.description: Connection to cancel, suspend, or terminate.

action.description: Type of lifecycle action to perform.

effective_date.description: When the action should take effect; omitted for immediate actions.

reason.description: Reason or justification for the lifecycle change.

billing_behavior.description: How billing should be handled in case of terminate/cancel.

notify_contacts.description: List of contact emails to notify about this action.

functions.returns: Confirmation of the requested lifecycle action with resulting or scheduled connection status.

functions.name: adjust_order_billing_after_provisioning
functions.description: Perform post-provisioning billing adjustments for an order, such as credits, surcharges, or dispute resolutions.

adjustments.description: List of billing adjustments to apply.

order_item_id.description: Order item ID when scope is item_level.

connection_id.description: Connection ID when scope is connection_level.

apply_immediately.description: If true, adjustments are applied immediately rather than on next invoice.

metadata.description: Additional metadata (e.g., dispute ticket ID, analyst ID).

functions.returns: Summary of posted billing adjustments, references to affected invoices, and any pending approvals.

functions.name: bulk_import_connectivity_orders
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple connectivity_orders from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined connectivity_orders, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_connectivity_orders
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of connectivity_orders matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped connectivity_orders with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_connectivity_orders
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of connectivity_orders with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_connectivity_orders
functions.description: Export a filtered set of connectivity_orders to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_connectivity_orders_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across connectivity_orders with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with connectivity_orders hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_order_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on order lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_order_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing order subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_order_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a order subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_order_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single order with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across connectivity_orders for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_order_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of connectivity_orders.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_order_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to connectivity_orders with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of order jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_order_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight order job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_order_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a order (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_order_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive order change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_order_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a order approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_order_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a order, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_order_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a order, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_order
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a order for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_order_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a order from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_order_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over connectivity_orders (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched connectivity_orders.

functions.name: build_order_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over connectivity_orders data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_order_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern order behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_order_policies
functions.description: List policies governing connectivity_orders with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_order_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a order and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
